mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.username, a.password_hash, a.display_name, r.role_code FROM dc_admin a JOIN dc_admin_role r ON r.id = a.role_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE a.username = #{username} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE dc_admin SET last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = 0
